controls.name: DRV
controls.doc: drive into the curve, +12 dB at 127 (TUBE/INFL output-compensated); 0 skips

controls.name: FOLD
controls.doc: wavefolder drive, 1x..48x into the fold at a held level; 0 = no folding

controls.name: WDTH
controls.doc: mid/side width, drawn -64..+63: 0 = untouched, -64 = mono, +63 = double the sides

controls.name: COMP
controls.doc: compression amount; 0 = no gain reduction at any level

controls.name: TONE
controls.doc: a tilt after the saturator in every mode: 64 flat, 127 bright, 0 dark

controls.name: MIX
controls.doc: dry/wet across the whole chain; 0 = exact passthrough

controls.name: SAT
controls.doc: character: TAPE (TapeHead), TUBE (DaTube, asymmetric), INFL (OInflator). JClones, MIT

controls.name: KEY
controls.doc: the compressor's key: SELF = this track's input, T1 = T1's level (ignored on the master)

controls.name: KLVL
controls.doc: how hard T1 drives the compressor with KEY = T1: 64 = unity, 127 = x2

euclid.proofNote: its own render gates; not on hardware

controls.name: FREQ
controls.doc: Base filter cutoff or AMP level; cutoff is 30 Hz..15 kHz logarithmic

controls.name: RES
controls.doc: Filter resonance; inert for AMP

controls.name: DEPTH
controls.doc: Cutoff or gain modulation: negative/down, zero/static, positive/up

controls.name: DECAY
controls.doc: Envelope decay up to eight steps / gate length; inert for random

controls.name: STEPS
controls.doc: Euclidean cycle length 1..64 (stored as length minus one)

controls.name: PULSE
controls.doc: Pulse count; values above STEPS are clamped to STEPS

controls.name: ROT
controls.doc: Shift rhythm and captured values right, modulo STEPS

controls.name: RATE
controls.doc: Division relative to the track speed; 1/16 = one track step

controls.name: TYPE
controls.doc: Two-pole low/high/band/notch filter response, or amplitude modulation

controls.name: ATK
controls.doc: Attack / gate edge / random slew, 0..one step

controls.name: OUT
controls.doc: Pulse envelope, timed gate, random sample-and-hold, captured random

controls.name: MIX
controls.doc: Dry/wet; zero is exact passthrough

controls.name: DECAY
controls.doc: feedback 0.65..0.97; fixed room size

controls.name: DAMP
controls.doc: higher values darken the tail

controls.name: MIX
controls.doc: dry/wet, smoothed; 0 dry, 127 wet

controls.name: MOD
controls.doc: two in-loop allpasses; smoothed 0..64 sample depth

controls.name: RATE
controls.doc: LFO speed: (value+1)*0.33646 Hz, continuous phase

controls.name: RATE
controls.doc: LFO speed, 0.08 .. 10 Hz on a squared taper (26 = the Juno's 0.5 Hz)

controls.name: DPTH
controls.doc: the sweep, 0 .. 480 samples either side of DLY; in PHSR the LFO's reach

controls.name: DLY
controls.doc: the sweep's centre, 0.2 .. 23 ms; COMB's pitch; PHSR's stage count (2/4/6/8 by quarters)

controls.name: FDBK
controls.doc: bipolar, 64 = none: feedback from the swept tap; PHSR regen; COMB decay time and polarity

controls.name: LOFI
controls.doc: the line clocked coarse and quantised: hold 1 + 64 (k/128)^2 samples, 24 bits then 16..5

controls.name: MIX
controls.doc: dry/wet; 0 = exact passthrough, 127 = the wet alone

controls.name: MODE
controls.doc: which pedal

controls.name: TONE
controls.doc: the BBD filters in and out of the line: 0 dark (2 kHz), 127 open; COMB brightness; no PHSR

controls.name: WDTH
controls.doc: the right channel LFO lag: 0 mono, 64 quadrature, 127 antiphase (Juno, DIM); not COMB

controls.name: FREQ
controls.doc: the cutoff, 60 Hz..15 kHz exponential; in VOWL the vowel A-E-I-O-U; ENV and LFO move it

controls.name: RES
controls.doc: the flavour: resonance in SEM/LADR, sharpness in VOWL, the dielectric colour in ISO

controls.name: ENV
controls.doc: the envelope follower onto the cutoff, drawn -64..+63; 0 = none

controls.name: LDP
controls.doc: LFO depth onto the cutoff, 0 = none (a negative depth would only flip the phase)

controls.name: LSP
controls.doc: LFO speed ~0.08..9 Hz, and the envelope release (0 slow .. 127 fast)

controls.name: WDTH
controls.doc: stereo width of the output, drawn -64..+63: 0 untouched, -64 mono, +63 double sides

controls.name: MODE
controls.doc: LADR the Moog (first); SEM the SVF (SHPE: LP -> BP -> HP); ISO (Capacitor2); VOWL

controls.name: SHPE
controls.doc: SEM only: 0 lowpass, 64 bandpass, 127 highpass, crossfaded; --- in the other modes

tapeecho.proofNote: the author's unit (OCTACLID4): six instances run, a seventh freezes it, open

controls.name: TIME
controls.doc: FREE: 46..231 ms; BEAT: twelve note divisions from 1/64 to dotted 1/4

controls.name: FDBK
controls.doc: repeat intensity; the upper range safely self-oscillates from tape noise

controls.name: WOW
controls.doc: 0.8 Hz wow plus irregular flutter; about 8 cents at 44, 22 cents at 127

controls.name: AGE
controls.doc: repeat bandwidth, flutter and noise; fresh at 0, worn at 127

controls.name: SYNC
controls.doc: FREE uses milliseconds; BEAT quantises TIME from stock tempo

controls.name: MIX
controls.doc: dry/wet crossfade; 0 is exact passthrough
